title: Red team exercises tied to UAP subject matter

tellings.quote: exercises um that were global and dealt very closely with other subject matter related to UAP were involved with those

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot, says that in the 1990s he took part in global red team exercises, drills where one side plays the enemy to test defences. He says these exercises were closely tied to UAP, the government's term for unidentified objects in the sky. He tells it as a sign the military was quietly preparing around the subject back then.
